top_news.title: What Does 99% Accuracy Measure? A Reproducible Audit of Shortcut Learning in a Widely Used Fake News Corpus
top_news.dek: Researchers find that the popular ISOT/Kaggle fake news corpus is fundamentally flawed due to metadata leakage.
top_news.brief: An audit of the widely used ISOT/Kaggle fake news dataset reveals that high accuracy scores are driven by shortcut learning rather than linguistic analysis. A simple classifier using only subject metadata achieved 100% F1, proving the benchmark is degenerate and unsuitable for evaluating model veracity.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing accuracy drop when metadata is removed from the dataset

top_news.title: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec): Sandbox Infrastructure for Effective Agentic Training at Scale
top_news.dek: DeepSeek introduces DSec, a sandbox infrastructure designed to scale agentic model training.
top_news.brief: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec) provides a specialized sandbox environment for training agentic AI systems. The infrastructure focuses on managing the complexities of large-scale agentic workflows, aiming to improve training efficiency and stability for autonomous model development.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram of the DSec infrastructure architecture

top_news.title: llm 0.36
top_news.dek: The llm CLI tool reaches version 0.36 with support for new OpenAI models.
top_news.brief: Version 0.36 of the llm command-line utility is now available, adding support for OpenAI's latest models, gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna. The update also introduces new capabilities for model plugins to declare supported features, improving integration for CLI-based AI workflows.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal screenshot showing llm CLI usage

top_news.title: New Anthropic, OpenAI models make same promise: A little more for a lot less money
top_news.dek: Frontier AI labs shift focus toward cost-efficiency as new model releases prioritize value.
top_news.brief: The competitive landscape for frontier AI models has transitioned from pure capability gains to aggressive price-to-performance optimization. Both OpenAI and Anthropic are releasing new models that offer incremental performance improvements while significantly reducing inference costs for developers.
top_news.image_alt: Comparison graph of model performance versus cost

top_news.title: Show HN: Training a model to identify AI web content from structure alone
top_news.dek: SlopShape uses structural analysis to detect AI-generated commercial content.
top_news.brief: Researchers have developed SlopShape, a method that identifies AI-generated commercial content by analyzing structural signatures rather than word-level patterns. By examining information flow, evidence presentation, and voice, the model successfully distinguishes between human-written blog posts and AI-generated mirrors across five frontier models.
top_news.image_alt: Visualization of structural patterns in AI vs human text

primary.title: Google Open-Sources AX a Kubernetes Style Orchestrator for Autonomous AI Agents
primary.summary: Google has open-sourced AX, an orchestrator designed for managing autonomous AI agent workloads. AX operates on a runtime, Agent Substrate, treating agents as stateful actors. It provides resource-efficient task suspension and resumption to optimise performance and reduce latency in idle phases. It features a control plane with Kubernetes-style primitives for managing agent tasks and resources. By Olimpiu Pop
